description:
Create a new identity. Its fingerprint is generated and frozen on the spot.

You do not choose the fingerprint — the point of the product is that every identity gets one self-consistent, frozen set of traits that stays byte-identical across restarts. Do not create identities speculatively: they count against the installation's quota.

Returns {name, os, created}. Fails with a readable message if the name is taken (409), if the quota is reached or the installation is unauthorized (403), or if an argument is rejected (422).

engine.description: which browser core backs the identity. Leave unset to use this installation's default; an unknown value is rejected with the list of accepted ones.

force_dark.description: personal display preference, OFF by default. true inverts web pages that have no dark theme of their own (Google Ads and the like) to dark; sites may notice the changed colors, so use it only on identities the user manages for themselves, never on accounts being built up. Leave unset to keep pages exactly as the sites render them. Chrome-engine identities only.

group.description: local ledger: which account, email, or purpose this identity is bound to

name.description: the new identity's name. Must be unique — creating a name that already exists fails rather than overwriting it.

proxy.description: exit proxy URL, e.g. "http://user:pass@host:port" or "socks5://host:port" — any vendor. Omit for a direct connection. Test it with proxy_check first.

urls.description: startup tabs — pages opened automatically when the identity starts

name: profile_create
